直道路段发生事故，两条车道被障碍物占用，混合智驾车队需要制动或绕行。: An accident blocks two lanes on a straight road. Mixed-automation traffic must brake or detour.
L0 可能因反应过晚发生碰撞；L1-L3 依次更早、更平稳地制动；L4 自动变道: L0 may react too late and collide; L1–L3 brake progressively earlier and more smoothly; L4 changes lanes; L5 plans a detour using infrastructure information.
密集交通中多辆相邻车道车辆连续切入主车道，检验不同智驾等级的应对差异。: Adjacent-lane vehicles repeatedly cut into dense traffic, testing responses across automation levels.
L0-L1 依赖驾驶员反应或预警；L2-L3 提前减速并保持车道；L4 自动选择: L0–L1 rely on driver reactions or warnings; L2–L3 slow down early and hold their lane; L4 chooses braking or a lane change; L5 uses communicated intentions to create safe gaps.
救护车从混合车队后方高速接近，车辆需要及时形成应急通道并在通过后恢复。: An ambulance approaches mixed traffic from behind. Vehicles must form an emergency corridor and return after it passes.
L0-L2 的发现和让行逐级改善；L3-L4 主动识别并形成通道；L5 通过车路: Detection and yielding improve from L0 to L2; L3–L4 proactively form a corridor; L5 uses infrastructure information to anticipate the ambulance route.
普通城市或园区道路，无雨雪、雾、积水和外界复杂干扰。道路为单向双车道，前方经过轻: A dry urban or campus road has two one-way lanes and a gentle bend. An L0 vehicle stops in the right lane. A following L0 changes left to avoid it and collides with an L0 in that lane. Both stop across the two lanes, blocking the road.
两次碰撞共涉及3辆行驶中的L0。首次碰撞发生时，后方车辆仍继续前进；第三辆L0与: Two collisions involve three moving L0 vehicles. After the first collision, a third L0 follows too closely, reacts late and rear-ends the stopped vehicles. The gaps and timing are shortened to intensify the event. L1 brakes hard; L3 detects that braking and slows gradually, leaving about a car length without collision. L0, L1 and L3 respond in the first 60 seconds. At 60 seconds all L5 vehicles enter the second stage, wait three seconds and follow their existing routes to turn right around the blockage. Ten background vehicles maintain safe gaps. Additional L0, L1 and L3 vehicles keep their departure order and form queues in both lanes. The eight L5 vehicles behind the leading pair are evenly distributed between the lanes at 60 seconds, retain their spatial layout, wait three seconds, then start together and merge before turning right.
双向城市快速路的正向道路包含3条主车道，右侧另有1条汇入车道；对向道路包含3条行: A two-way urban arterial has three main lanes and a right-side merging lane in one direction, and three lanes in the opposite direction. Mixed L0–L3 traffic enters continuously.
第0秒时画面最上方3条对向车道已经由随机错位、不同初速度的车流铺满整段道路；后续: At time zero, staggered opposing traffic with varied initial speeds already fills the upper three lanes. Later vehicles enter in irregular batches of one to three. Mainline and ramp demand stay unchanged. Merging between 10 and 22 seconds first slows D1, then affects D2 and D3; mainline traffic recovers after 22 seconds.
使用与低智驾场景完全相同的正向3车道、单汇入车道和对向3车道路网，以L5车辆为主: The same three-lane mainline, single ramp and three opposing lanes are used, with mostly L5 vehicles and a few L3/L4 vehicles following the same cooperative merging policy.
交汇侧D3车道与支路通过预设车隙连续交替通行，偶尔允许两辆支路车连续插入。全程保: D3 and ramp traffic alternate through planned gaps, occasionally allowing two ramp vehicles consecutively. Cruising remains stable without evasive D1–D2 or D2–D3 lane changes.
接近障碍物后才开始弱制动，碰撞风险最高。: Weak braking starts only near the obstacle, giving the highest collision risk.
告警后紧急制动，反应较晚，仍可能发生追尾。: Emergency braking follows a warning, but late response can still cause a rear-end collision.
纵向辅助分级制动，减小冲击并降低碰撞数量。: Staged longitudinal assistance reduces impact and collisions.
提前感知障碍物，以更平稳的减速度停车。: Early obstacle detection enables a smoother stop.
自主判断安全间隙，优先变道绕过障碍物。: Selects a safe gap and prefers changing lanes around the obstacle.
接收路侧障碍信息，提前规划车道与速度。: Uses roadside obstacle information to plan speed and lane choice early.
依赖驾驶员临场反应，频繁急刹且碰撞数量较多。: Relies on immediate driver reactions, with frequent hard braking and more collisions.
提供危险预警并辅助制动，但应对连续加塞有限。: Provides warnings and braking assistance, with limited response to repeated cut-ins.
持续控制纵向间距，降低单次加塞的冲突程度。: Maintains longitudinal gaps to reduce the impact of individual cut-ins.
识别相邻车辆意图，提前减速形成安全间隙。: Anticipates adjacent vehicles and slows down early to create safe gaps.
自动选择减速或换道，保持更高的通行效率。: Chooses braking or lane changes automatically to maintain throughput.
利用车车意图信息提前调整间隙与目标车道。: Uses shared vehicle intentions to adjust gaps and target lanes in advance.
救护车贴近后才观察到并执行较晚的人工让行。: The driver notices the ambulance late and yields only when it is close.
通过后方接近预警提醒驾驶员准备变道。: Rear-approach warnings prompt the driver to prepare a lane change.
辅助保持安全间距，并在可用间隙内完成让行。: Assists with safe gaps and yields when space becomes available.
主动识别应急车辆，较早选择相邻车道。: Recognizes the emergency vehicle and selects an adjacent lane early.
自动规划让行轨迹，救护车通过后恢复行驶。: Plans a yielding trajectory automatically and resumes after the ambulance passes.
通过车路协同提前获知路线并率先形成通道。: Uses infrastructure information to anticipate the route and form a corridor first.
停车车辆诱发前车变道碰撞；后方L0发现过晚并追尾，新增L0保持直行并正常制动。: A parked vehicle triggers a lane-change collision; a following L0 reacts late and rear-ends the vehicles. Added L0 vehicles stay straight and brake normally.
原有L1先轻微减速再紧急制动，新增L1保持直行并正常制动。: The original L1 slows slightly before braking hard; added L1 vehicles stay straight and brake normally.

少量混入车流，保持巡航速度并遵循交替通行次序。: A small share maintains cruising speed and follows the alternating order.
作为主体车流提前预留汇入间隙，保持三条主车道稳定通行。: The main traffic reserves merging gaps early and keeps all three main lanes stable.
